SELECT p.part_id, COALESCE(s.setl_stat_cd IN ('CNFM', 'AUTO'), false) AS confirmed, s.mod_dttm FROM tb_bs_part p LEFT JOIN tb_co_part_setl s ON s.part_id = p.part_id AND s.setl_ym = #{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.hist_id, h.bfr_val FROM tb_sy_chg_hist h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm = 'TB_BS_PART' AND h.trgt_key = p.part_id AND h.chg_item_nm = '사용 여부' AND h.reg_dttm >= #{nextMonthStart,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ORDER BY h.reg_dttm ASC, h.hist_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) after_month ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.hist_id, h.bfr_val FROM tb_sy_chg_hist h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm = 'TB_BS_PART' AND h.trgt_key = p.part_id AND h.chg_item_nm = '사용 여부' AND h.reg_dttm >= (to_date(#{month} || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') ORDER BY h.reg_dttm ASC, h.hist_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) from_month ON true WHERE p.hq_yn != 'Y'
AND (CASE WHEN from_month.hist_id IS NULL THEN p.use_yn ELSE from_month.bfr_val END = 'Y' OR CASE WHEN after_month.hist_id IS NULL THEN p.use_yn ELSE after_month.bfr_val END = 'Y' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_chg_hist w WHERE w.trgt_tbl_nm = 'TB_BS_PART' AND w.trgt_key = p.part_id AND w.chg_item_nm = '사용 여부' AND w.reg_dttm >= (to_date(#{month} || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AND w.reg_dttm < #{nextMonthStart,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND 'Y' IN (w.bfr_val, w.aft_val))) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_bs_part_std criteria WHERE criteria.part_id = p.part_id AND criteria.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (criteria.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR criteria.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ) ORDER BY p.part_id
